narration: MCP is a common way for AI applications to connect to tools and data. Here is what actually happens behind that connection.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.

narration: Start with three parts: your AI application, an MCP client inside it, and an MCP server that exposes capabilities from another system.
captionText: The host manages its MCP client.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.

narration: First, the client discovers what the server supports. It can list tools and read their descriptions and input requirements before calling one.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.

narration: For example, you ask the AI to find a project file. The client sends a tool call with a search query to the server.
onScreenText: A request becomes a tool call.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.

narration: The server runs that tool against the connected system and returns a result. The AI application can then use that result to answer you.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.

narration: The same pattern can connect to files, a database, or another service. MCP standardizes the exchange; each server still needs to implement its own capabilities.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.

narration: In the July twenty twenty-six specification, the core is stateless: each request carries the relevant protocol metadata. Access permissions still matter, and sensitive actions still need appropriate controls.
captionText: MCP does not grant unlimited access.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.

narration: So an MCP server is a program exposing capabilities, not another AI model. Next, we will pull an app apart into the layers behind its screen.
captionText: Next: the layers behind your app.
voiceDirection: Warm, clear and conversational. Pronounce MCP as M-C-P and AI as A-I. Read verbatim.
